info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Loan By Loan Id-spec
info.description: The Loan Management API facilitates the effective management of loan records within the financial services domain. This operation allows for the removal of a specific loan identified by its unique loan ID. Typical consumers of this API include banking and financial institutions seeking to maintain accurate loan data. Use cases include loan cancellations, corrections, or administrative cleanups in loan management systems.

delete.summary: Remove a loan by its ID.
delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specific loan identified by its unique loan ID. Make sure that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action, as it will permanently remove the loan from the system.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting a specific loan identified by LOAN-500045. Ensure that the provided data adheres to the expected schema for the deletion operation. This request confirms the user's intention to delete the specified loan from the system.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.
